rules.quote: For manuscripts, an abstract of not more than 250 words is allowable.
References should appear in a separate reference section at the end of this paper with items referred to by numerals in square brackets.
The page limit is 14 pages for regular papers and 16 pages for review papers including supplementary material.

rules.value: objective, methods, major results, conclusions, one sentence significance
rules.quote: The abstract should indicate the objective of the study, methods, major results, conclusions, and one sentence significance to biomedical research.

rules.value: no abbreviations, footnotes, references or equations
rules.quote: The abstract should be without abbreviations, footnotes, references, or mathematical equations.

value: innovation and significance in relation to JBHI scope
entirely original, not copyrighted, published, submitted or accepted elsewhere
rules.quote: Confirm that the manuscript is entirely original, has not been copyrighted, published, submitted, or accepted for publication elsewhere

rules.value: IEEE single spaced, double column, embedded figures and tables
rules.quote: All submissions must be in IEEE single spaced, double column format with embedded figures and tables

rules.value: cite original source of public data
rules.quote: If the data are derived from a publicly available database, the original source and reference must be provided.

rules.value: signed consent form from all authors, uploaded as supporting document
rules.quote: The consent form with a hand-written signature must be uploaded as a supporting document along with the manuscript submission.
All IEEE journals require an Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) for all authors.

rules.value: institutional or IEEE email for all authors
rules.quote: It is obligatory for all the authors to use their institutional email or IEEE email
Authors are encouraged to suggest 4 potential reviewers although they may not be requested to review the particular submission.
